data.comment: Heading of the list of what is planned.

data.name: ComingNextHint
data.value: In the order they are planned. Plans can change, so there are no dates.

data.name: ComingNext1
data.value: A way for others to help translate Stikling.
data.comment: The planned items are listed in the order they are planned.

data.name: ComingNext5
data.value: Showing it off: a plant's anniversary on Today, an experiment's result as a picture to post, your year as a video, and a plant's story to print.

data.name: ComingNext6
data.value: When something is wrong: a check of what you see on a plant with what to look at next, and short guides that work offline.

data.name: ComingNext7
data.value: Naming a plant from a photo, a card with facts about its species, and a page to show your collection to others.

data.name: OlderEntriesEnglish
data.value: Older entries are only in English.
data.comment: Shown above the first entry that is not translated.

data.name: Oct2026Danish
data.value: Stikling is now in Danish. It follows the language your browser is set to, and you can pick one in Settings under Language.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes. New lines are added here, in English and Danish, with a key named for the month and what changed.

data.name: Nov2026Moments
data.value: Today says when a plant has been with you another year, and a first root, first leaf or a cutting becoming a plant gets a short moment of its own, with Share right there.
data.comment: Line on the What's new page, in November 2026.

data.name: Nov2026BrowseDictionary
data.value: A plant dictionary to browse: groups like aroids and cacti, families, every genus and species with where it grows wild, and what you have of each.
data.comment: Line on the What's new page, in November 2026.

data.name: Nov2026Tour
data.value: The tour is easier to follow, and browsers no longer try to translate Stikling when it's already in your language.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes. New lines are added here, in English and Danish, with a key named for the month and what changed.

data.name: Nov2026Dictionary
data.value: A plant's page shows its family and the places it grows wild. The dictionary has every cactus and succulent from Kew's checklist, and more cultivars.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026Generation
data.value: Plants and cuttings say which generation they are, like 3rd generation from the kitchen Monstera, on the page, the family tree and as a table column.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026Orders
data.value: Orders: keep track of plants you've bought until they arrive, then unpack the box and each plant is added with its seller and price.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026Passkeys
data.value: Add a passkey on the Account page, so you can sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes. New lines are added here, in English and Danish, with a key named for the month and what changed.

data.name: Nov2026ShelfPhotos
data.value: Shelf photos: take a photo of a shelf or a room and put a dot on each plant. Tap a dot to see which plant it is. The photo also shows on the history of each plant in it.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026AddPhotos
data.value: Photos from your gallery can be added to a plant in one go from the new Add photos page, and on Android from the share menu where the browser allows it.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026UpdatesStuck
data.value: Updates no longer get stuck on some phones, where the app could stay on an old version without ever offering the new one.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026RoundFeed
data.value: On Water plants, the feed picker at the top is now called Feed for the rest, and says how many plants get their own feed.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026LeafLog
data.value: A leaf log for variegated plants: log each new leaf with a photo and how variegated it is, and see when a plant starts to revert.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026Wick
data.value: A homemade self-watering setup can stand in the water or use a wick. Pick which on the plant, next to Keep water in the outer pot.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026PotColours
data.value: Pots no longer need a name, and can have a colour. An unnamed pot is called after its colour and material, like White ceramic outer pot.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026SameAngle
data.value: Same angle: a new button next to Photo opens Stikling's own camera with a faint copy of an earlier photo over the picture, so a plant is photographed from the same angle every time.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026PotOutsideSize
data.value: A pot is now measured on the outside, the same way pots are sold, outer pots too. Add how wide the rim or wall is, and the Pots page shows how wide the pot is inside.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026DictionaryWide
data.value: On a computer, the plant dictionary uses the whole screen, with long lists of species and cultivars in columns.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026WideScreens
data.value: On a computer, Plants and Propagations use the whole screen with the filters in a column down the left, Pots shows one card per pot name, and Today puts Worth a look in the main column when nothing is due.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026LongForms
data.value: On a computer, the forms for adding or editing a plant or a cutting put More details beside the main fields, so there is less to scroll.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026PotTiles
data.value: When you pick a pot for a plant, pots with a photo show it as a large tile, so similar pots are easier to tell apart. Help also says how to delete a plant you added by mistake.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026DropAndShiftClick
data.value: On a computer, drag photos onto a plant or onto its row in the list to add them, and shift-click in Select to pick a whole run of plants or cuttings.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026QuickActions
data.value: Press and hold a plant in the list to water it or add a note without opening it. On a computer, right-click it.

data.name: Nov2026Units
data.value: Settings can now show lengths in inches, write dates month first or year first, and use a 12-hour clock.
data.comment: A line on the list of changes.

data.name: Nov2026ExperimentPicture
data.value: An experiment can be shared as a picture: each medium with how many rooted and how long it took.

data.name: Nov2026SemiHydro
data.value: Plants in LECA or PON can have a fill line, a note of how full the reservoir is when you check, and a flush reminder that covers all of them.

data.name: Nov2026PotFit
data.value: Does it fit? on the Pots page shows which of your free outer pots a nursery pot goes in.

data.name: Nov2026CheckByMethod
data.value: The note on Today about how to tell if a plant needs water now also goes by how the plant is watered: from the bottom, from the top or soaked.
